description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the percentage breakdown of "Matched" and "Not Matched" outcomes across six different evaluation categories. The vertical axis displays the categories, listed from bottom to top as Correct, Rigorous, a category with its text label completely obscured by a gray rectangle, Active, Oriented, and No Hallucination. This axis does not have an explicit title, and the categories are not sorted in alphabetical or numerical order. The horizontal axis represents the percentage value on a linear scale ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick marks and labels at regular intervals of 20%. Each bar is stacked to total exactly 100% and is divided into two color-coded segments defined by an inset legend: a dark blue segment on the left representing "Matched" and a light blue segment on the right representing "Not Matched." Every segment is explicitly annotated with its exact percentage; the "Matched" values are written in white text within the dark blue sections, while the "Not Matched" values are in black text within the light blue sections. The "Matched" component accounts for the vast majority of every bar, with the highest value observed in the "Correct" category at 99.00% (leaving 1.00% for "Not Matched") and the lowest in the obscured category at 94.00% (leaving 6.00% for "Not Matched"). The remaining categories display "Matched" percentages of 95.33% for Rigorous, 97.00% for Active, 97.33% for Oriented, and 98.33% for No Hallucination, alongside their respective "Not Matched" complements of 4.67%, 3.00%, 2.67%, and 1.67%.
